set.st: In 1924 about $11,200 was stolen from a farmer near Beaver by a relative, who pleaded guilty. About $3,000 was recovered buried on the farm and several thousand more turned up in Minneapolis. In Apr 1925 the thief's lawyers said she confessed that upwards of $5,000 remained buried about 20 feet west of a small birch tree on the farm, some 30 paces to the left of where the recovered $3,000 had been dug up. On the night of 25 Apr 1925 twenty-two men dug by lantern and flashlight under armed guard, joined by the sheriff's men, and found nothing; no later find was reported. Pin is approximate, not the spot itself.
set.t: Caution: the 1924 court record says $6,000 was found buried on the farm and the rest was invested in St. Paul; the 1925 'still buried' claim came via the lawyers. No later recovery reported 1925-40. If placed, search west of the old recovery hole; the 1925 birch is long gone. Private: permission.
set.pl: GNIS Beaver (Marinette County); the farm is not yet placed (needs a c.1912-25 Beaver Twp plat)
